messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.text:
A rejected proposal doesn’t keep the refund window open. Although your seat cushion was returned, the earlier rejected request does not count as an in-time request for this purpose, so a new request made after the deadline would be late (refund-policy/v2/window; refund-policy/v2/return).

The record shows the proposal was created on November 2, 2026. If you’d like, I can check whether a new request is still within the deadline.
